subject: Error message for multiple imputation with WLSMV

messages.author: 0ee8ae7c0d185529
messages.subject: Error message for multiple imputation with WLSMV
parts:
Greeings,

Below you'll see some code as well as an error message I am receiving when running a path model using WLSMV and multiple imputation.  The program seems to work on a PC but I am using a Mac.  R and RStudio are up to date.  Any advice would be appreciated, or perhaps there is a better way to run MI with flexibility in the various lavaan estimators.

Thanks

David
-------------------------------

install.packages("lavaan")
install.packages("semTools")
install.packages("mice")
require(semTools)
require(lavaan)
require(mice)

## Science Achievement Example
## Kaplan (2009, pg. 15)
scimodel <- read.csv(file.choose(),header=T)

## Generate some missing values ####
scimodel$ses[scimodel$ses >=.9] <- NA
scimodel$sciach[scimodel$sciach >=30.00] <- NA
scimodel$scigrade6[scimodel$scigrade6 == 1] <- NA


pathmodel <- ' 

# regressions
sciach ~ scigrade10
scigrade10 ~ scigrade6+ses+certsci+understand+challenge
challenge~understand
understand ~ certsci

'

### Multiple Imputation Predictive Mean Matching ###

scimodel[,c("understand","challenge","scigrade10","certsci")] <-
  lapply(scimodel[,c("understand","challenge","scigrade10","certsci")],ordered)
fitmi <- sem.mi(pathmodel,data=scimodel,estimator="wlsmv",ordered=paste0("y",1:7),m=5,seed=12345,miPackage="mice",chi="lmrr",
miArgs=list(method=c("pmm","pmm","pmm","pmm","pmm","pmm","pmm"),ords=c("y1","y2","y3","y4","y5","y6","y7")))
summary(fitmi,fit.measures=TRUE)
inspect(fitmi, "fit")


Error in checkSlotAssignment(object, name, value) : 
  assignment of an object of class “lavModel” is not valid for slot ‘Model’ in an object of class “lavaanStar”; is(value, "Model") is not TRUE
In addition: Warning message:
In lav_data_full(data = data, group = group, cluster = cluster,  :
  lavaan WARNING: exogenous variable(s) declared as ordered in data: certsci
> summary(fitmi,fit.measures=TRUE)
Error in summary(fitmi, fit.measures = TRUE) : object 'fitmi' not found
> inspect(fitmi, "fit")
Error in inspect(fitmi, "fit") : object 'fitmi' not found

messages.subject: Re: Error message for multiple imputation with WLSMV
parts: perhaps there is a better way to run MI with flexibility in the various lavaan estimators.

runMI() should work with all the estimators described on the ?lavOptions help page.  From the error message I can see semTools 0.4-14 is still installed, because the development version does not have any trace of the old lavaanStar object. 

It is necessary for the development version of lavaan to be installed before the development version of semTools can be installed, so make sure to install them in this order:

install.packages("lavaan", repos = "http://www.da.ugent.be", type = "source")
devtools::install_github("simsem/semTools/semTools")

I haven't tried it on my Mac, but it shouldn't be a problem when installing from source / github (assuming you have R >= 3.3 installed).
